subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this remain a distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` recovery and UI-history issue, or be folded into the broader Telegram guarded-lane and ambiguous-delivery work?
rationale: The shared `send_attempt_started` recovery gap overlaps existing work, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and `chat.history` pressure that are not fully owned by those items.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery path and any confirmed Control UI history burst.

options.title: Fold Into Delivery Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history symptoms as incidental and track the remaining recovery semantics through the existing guarded-lane and ambiguous-delivery items.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and open or select a separate canonical item for the `chat.history` latency burst.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove and fix the `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery path and any confirmed Control UI history burst.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans shared outbound recovery semantics, Telegram delivery safety, and whether to split the Control UI history symptom.
